chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Mu‘allā Abī ‘Uthmān, from Mu‘allā ibn Khunays, from Abī ‘Abd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
The end of the time of al-‘atamah is midnight.

key_terms.وَقْتِ: the appointed time of an act of worship
key_terms.ٱلْعَتَمَةِ: the night prayer time, referring to al-‘Isha’

ai.seo_question: Until when does the time of al-‘atamah last?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the final time for al-‘atamah prayer is half of the night. It is a concise legal ruling concerning the prescribed time limit of the night prayer.
